summary: Wired 16 cards for issue #566 (a wireability pass across War of Honor/Embers of War/Honor and Treachery/The Shadow's Embrace/Forgotten Legacy), plus Wanted for Questioning and Humble Farm/Humble Farmers added mid-pass once their own blockers resolved: Fury of the Sea, Tempest of Flame, A Warrior's Wisdom, Desperate Mediation, Game of Sincerity, Inexorable (Mendon's ruling: negates the whole announced Reaction, not only a negation -- R-024), Inspirational Address, Shameful Death, Shameful Rebuke, Striking Through the Void, The Lion's Charge, Diamond Mine, The Seekers' Temple, Wanted for Questioning (Mendon's ruling: custody is flavor text -- R-025), Humble Farm and its created Humble Farmers Follower (a user-supplied scan, confirmed genuine after an earlier mismatch). New reusable primitives: a two-step turn-order decider chain (Desperate Mediation/Shameful Rebuke), a whole-Reaction negation reaction (Inexorable), an Effect-keyed Fire-or-Void attach restriction/discount and static Force bonus (Tempest of Flame). This is rules-lane work (Mendon, standing cross-lane authority); it is flagged 'shared' only because published card art/catalogue files live under src/L5R.Client/Content -- plain published-card assets and the shared catalogue-art manifest, not UI code, so no UI review is needed. Catalogue art pack rebuilt and republished (catalogue-art-issue566-20260930-r1) to cover all 16 new scans.
validation: Full Core test suite: 2164/2164 passing. New CardWave566Tests.cs: 16 scenarios (published shape + one real gameplay scenario per wired card) all passing. bash tools/check.sh --skip-client: all requested checks passed (Core/AI/Server/Client.Transport test projects, all Python tool test suites). dotnet format whitespace clean. Catalogue art coverage test passes against the republished pack. Three pre-existing guard-test regressions fixed for real (AttackPerformerAuditTests, ForgottenLegacyBatch4Tests, ShadowsEmbraceBatch6Tests, PlayerTargetTests inventories updated for the new ability ids).
remaining: Bayushi Nitoshi - inexperienced (oracle-l5r-10248) deliberately excluded: needs a new BattleOrLimited Timing combo touching ~20 files, out of scope for this wave. Embracing Virtue and Regret assessed and dropped: Embracing Virtue needs a new phase-boundary reaction-window primitive (parallel to BeforeResolution.cs but for the End Phase); Regret's Focus Effect half is buildable but its Open half needs a new multi-card/independent-host attach primitive that doesn't exist, so the whole card was left out rather than half-built. Prideful Allies and Begone, Fool! excluded per Mendon's own ruling (multiplayer-only, useless until multiplayer exists). None; ready for review. The catalogue art pack (catalogue-art-issue566-20260930-r1) has been built, verified and published as a GitHub Release.
